title: Phase-stable voltage bias for Josephson photonics devices
summary: Parametric interactions are foundational to superconducting quantum technologies, yet conventional microwave-driven pumping introduces parasitic Kerr nonlinearities and higher-order harmonics that limit device performance. Josephson Photonics (JP) avoids these parasitics by utilizing dc-biased junctions but has remained constrained by high phase noise and the absence of a stable phase reference.
